name: AKG N90Q Smart Wireless Noise Cancelling Headphones
description: AKG N90Q — AKG's flagship 'smart' noise-cancelling headphone, in excellent condition. This is the one that auto-tunes itself: it measures your ear's acoustic response and calibrates the sound to your exact hearing, with real reference-tuning knobs on the aluminum ear cups so you can dial in your preferred tonal balance on the fly. Auto-noise-cancelling (full, ambient, or off), works wirelessly via Bluetooth or wired via the included cables, and charges over the supplied USB cable. Rock-solid aluminum build, plush memory-foam ear pads, and great battery life. Excellent cosmetic and working condition, thoroughly cleaned. From a pet-friendly home (a cat lives here) but sanitized. Does NOT come with an extra storage bag — please bring your own pouch for pickup.
contact_note: Flagship AKG 'smart' ANC headphones — auto-tunes to your ears, has real tuning knobs, BT + wired + USB charging. Excellent condition and fully sanitized. Does NOT come with an extra storage bag; please bring your own pouch for pickup. Pet-friendly home.
meta_description: AKG N90Q flagship 'smart' wireless ANC headphones in excellent condition — auto-tunes to your ears, manual tuning knobs, BT + wired, USB charging.
name_zh: AKG N90Q 旗舰智能无线降噪头戴耳机（成色极佳）
description_zh: 转让 AKG 旗舰级 N90Q 智能降噪头戴耳机，成色极佳。它最特别的卖点是『智能调音』：会测量你的耳道声学响应并自动校准音质到最适合你的状态，同时铝合金耳罩上还配有真实的参考调音旋钮，可随时微调你偏好的听感。支持自动降噪（强降噪/通透/关闭）、蓝牙无线或附带的有线连接，USB 充电。铝合金机身坚固、记忆海绵耳垫舒适、续航出色。外观与功能均为极佳状态，发布前已彻底清洁消毒。此前来自养猫的家庭，请知悉。不附带额外收纳袋，自提请自备小袋。
